sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: Official resale program of Patagonia, backed by the brand's quality and sustainability ethos, focusing on extending product lifecycles and reducing environmental impact through reuse and repair.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Patagonia Worn Wear is an initiative by Patagonia that offers a platform to buy and sell pre-loved Patagonia outdoor apparel and gear. It aims to extend the life of clothing, reduce waste, and promote a circular economy by keeping gear in use longer.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Used outdoor apparel and gear including outerwear
fleece
rainwear
kids & baby clothing
shirts
jackets
and packs.

sections.label: Pricing
sections.content: Direct sales of used goods at discounted prices; credit offered for eligible trade-in items.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Environmentally conscious consumers, outdoor enthusiasts, individuals seeking durable and lower-priced Patagonia gear, and those looking to trade in their used Patagonia items.
